title: グーグルのスマホ、箱に壁紙にアート　盛岡の企業「ヘラルボニー」とコラボ、多様性伝える
extracted_text: グーグルが、知的障害のある作家が描くアートの商品化に取り組む盛岡市の企業「ヘラルボニー」とコラボし、壁紙などにアートを採用したスマートフォンを5月20日に発売する。 鮮やかな青を基調とした無数の点。スマホの箱には岩手県花巻市の故・工藤みどりさんの絵画「（無題）（青）」をあしらった。画面の壁紙は工藤さんら複数の作家の作品を用いた。 同社は双子の松田文登さん（34）と崇弥さん（34）が、重度の知的障害を伴う自閉症のある兄、翔太さん（38）に向けられる冷たい視線を変えたいとの思いから、2018年に創業。作家約300人と契約し、作品の商品化やデザインの使用権管理をしている。 グーグルが昨年打診し企画が実現。「ピクセル10a」の特別モデルは、作家の「異彩」を通して多様性を紹介する意図と、世界自閉症啓発デーのシンボルカラーの青を合わせ「Isai Blue」と名づけられた。ヘラルボニーの嵯峨山恵美さんは「毎日触れるスマホに採用されたのはうれしい」と話した。
translated_text: Google has partnered with Morioka-based company Herarbony, which works to commercialize art created by writers with intellectual disabilities, and will release a phone featuring art in wallpapers and other elements on May 20. Countless vibrant blue dots form the basis of the design. The phone box features the painting "(Untitled) (Blue)" by the late Midori Kudo from Hanamaki, Iwate Prefecture. The screen wallpaper uses works by Kudo and several other artists. The company was founded in 2018 by twin brothers Fumito Matsuda (34) and Takuya Matsuda (34), who wanted to change the cold stares directed at their older brother Shota (38), who has severe intellectual disabilities and autism. Herarbony has contracted with approximately 300 writers and handles the commercialization of their works and the management of design usage rights. Google approached them last year, and the project came to fruition. The special "Pixel 10a" model has been named "Isai Blue," with the intention of showcasing diversity through the artists' "unique brilliance" and incorporating the blue symbolic color of World Autism Awareness Day. Herarbony's Emi Sagayama said, "We are happy that it was adopted for a phone that people touch every day."
title_en: Google Phone Features Art on Box and Wallpaper | Collaboration with Morioka Company Herarbony to Promote Diversity
